name: Bio model workflow: checks, sensitivity, identification, design re-verified under uncertainty
description: An SBML or library biological model (epidemic, excitable cell, PK/PD, enzyme network) checked for conservation, positivity and the SBML round trip, simulated with a stiffness-aware solver, verified against closed forms (SIR final size, PK AUC, the HH threshold), analysed for local and Sobol sensitivity, identified from data, used for an intervention or dosing design and re-verified under parameter uncertainty (pinneapple_physics.biology.workflow).

params.title: Bio model workflow: checks, sensitivity, identification, design re-verified under uncertainty
